node.statement: At every matrix level, A_R is an (L^0*epsilon)-C*-algebra by the direct-corner envelope. Since epsilon>=0 and W.L>=L^0, one has 0<=L^0*epsilon<=epsilon_R:=W.L*epsilon. In each defining estimate of def-epsilon-cstar-algebra, replacing L^0*epsilon by epsilon_R enlarges an upper-error allowance (product, associativity, and approximate-unit estimates) or lowers the C*-lower-bound right-hand side; the exact involution identities are unchanged. Therefore each M_n tensor A_R is an epsilon_R-C*-algebra, so def-extended-epsilon-cstar-algebra gives that A_R is an extended epsilon_R-C*-algebra.
